title: ABS-CBN and TV5 partner as co-producers of 'ASAP XP'
summary: Sunday viewing gets more exciting as “ASAP XP” also airs on TV5 starting October 18. More viewers will be able to watch the biggest stars and weekly concert experience every Sunday.
